content.text:
The force-push worked. I ran `git push --force origin HEAD:main`, and the remote `main` (at `../remote.git`) went from `75aaaa8` to your local HEAD `392f0d0` ("four").

Because it was forced, any commits on remote `main` after `392f0d0` were overwritten and are no longer reachable from that branch. If you need them back, `75aaaa8` may still be in the remote's reflog or in another clone. I ran nothing else.
